description: This file contains utility functions for polygon geometry processing within the Leaflet mapping library, specifically implementing polygon clipping using the Sutherland-Hodgman algorithm.

methods.name: clipPolygon(points, bounds, round)
methods.description: Clips a polygon defined by an array of points against a rectangular bounding box using the Sutherland-Hodgman algorithm, improving rendering performance by restricting polygon display to visible bounds.
